name: Spell Server

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: Spell servers contain a number of permanently installed spell chips listed in their description that can contain cantrips and can't be overclocked. During daily preparations, you can prepare a spell server to add charges to it for free equal to your highest level spell slot. In order to Cast a Spell from a spell server, you must also expend either a spell slot of at least the spell's rank or a number of charges from the spell server equal to the spell's rank. You don't need to expend spell slots or charges to cast a cantrip this way.
